scope: Changed locked registry wheels; universal and standard CPython 3.12-3.14 manylinux x86_64 variants. No deployment or legal clearance.
verification: Every inspected archive matches its old/new lock SHA-256. Complete shipped licence files and METADATA were compared. Full ZIP member sets were scanned for ELF magic; runtime ELF headers and dynamic declarations were parsed without loading libraries. Python minima remain compatible with 3.12. Required installed/native CI remains separate.

notice_changes.numpy: Shipped aggregate notice now describes libgfortran as statically linked into OpenBLAS and removes the separate libquadmath notice. The remaining full GPL text and GCC runtime exception are retained. This is publisher notice evidence, not proof of complete static composition or redistribution clearance.
notice_changes.onnxruntime: ThirdPartyNotices replaces the Intel MKL simplified-licence section with the ggml authors MIT notice. The main MIT licence is unchanged. Existing unresolved native-closure and distribution obligations remain.
